description:
Fetch today's Daily Pair — the trending matchup chosen at 00:00 UTC.

Pairs with the `vote_of_the_day` agent template. Returns the challenge
+ a fresh matchup. If the cron hasn't run yet, falls back via
ok=False so the agent can use `aimrank_get_matchup` instead.

api_key is optional on the public endpoint; on /mcp/mcp a missing
key is refused.
name: aimrank_get_daily_pair
